message.content: In the dialogue provided, LiHua mentions a memorable moment for the "Man in Black" in Westworld. Specifically, LiHua says, "Yeah, that moment when he finally confronts the truth about himself and his choices. That moment of realization definitely stands out! It’s such a turning point for his character." This indicates that LiHua finds the pivotal moment where the "Man in Black" faces his inner truths to be particularly memorable.
